title: AI Community of Practice weekly gathering

---

Join the AI Community of Practice for its weekly gathering starting January 21, 2026, at 10 a.m. This virtual meeting, hosted on Zoom, offers an opportunity for participants to engage in discussions about artificial intelligence, share insights, and collaborate on projects. Attendees can expect to network with like-minded individuals, learn about the latest trends in AI, and contribute to ongoing initiatives within the community. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, this gathering is designed to foster learning and innovation in the field of artificial intelligence. Don’t miss the chance to connect and expand your knowledge!
